newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: JG Summit 1996 net seen at 3.2 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: JG Summit 1996 net seen at 3.2 bln pesos.

text.p: The net income of JG Summit Holdings Inc is expected to hit 3.2 billion pesos in 1996 from the year-ago 2.883 billion, executive vice president Lance Gokongwei told Reuters on Monday.
"We forecast our net income for 1996 to reach 3.2 billion pesos," Gokongwei said.
The conglomerate's profits for 1997 is projected to reach 3.6 billion pesos, he said.

Gokongwei said the increase in JG Summit's net income in 1996 will primarily come from its food units, real estate arm Robinsons Land Corp, Digital Telecommunications Phils Inc (Digitel), and equity earnings from banking affiliates Philippine Commercial International Bank and Far East Bank and Trust Co.
"For 1997, I expect Robinsons and Digitel to lead the way in terms of growth," Gokongwei said.
